info.title: FINAUDIT AI API
info.description: Financial PDF ingestion, layout-aware parsing, evidence provenance, layout-aware retrieval and evidence-grounded QA. Answers are validated against cited evidence; this is not financial auditing.

post.description:
Validate and store a PDF, then queue it for background processing (202 Accepted).

Metadata fields are optional and stored exactly as supplied; nothing is inferred.  When no
title is given we use the PDF's embedded title metadata, else the file name.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api V1 Documents Get
Response Get Pages Api V1 Documents  Doc Id  Pages Get
Response Get Evidence Api V1 Documents  Doc Id  Evidence Get

get.description: Render a page of the original PDF to PNG (PyMuPDF).  Use with `bboxNormalized` for overlays.
Crop a block's bbox (e.g. a figure/chart or table region) from the original PDF page.

post.description: Queue (re-)indexing.  Deterministic: chunk ids are stable and previous chunks/vectors are replaced.

get.description: Configuration and health of the retrieval/QA stack.  Never returns secrets.

schema.title: Response Index Status Api V1 Index Status Get

get.description:
Normalized FinancialFacts (one per table value cell) with row, column/period, scale, currency, scope and
cell bbox.  Unknown metadata is reported as unknown.  The original parse is unchanged.

schema.title: Response Document Facts Api V1 Documents  Doc Id  Facts Get

get.description: Full detail for a cited evidence chunk: text, section, exact page/block/bbox regions, image URLs.

503.description: No LLM provider configured or reachable

post.description:
Read a chart with the configured vision-language model.  All values are visual estimates and are
cross-checked against the document's table evidence.

value.title: Value
value.description: Exact decimal result from the deterministic calculator or a quoted operand

caveat.title: Caveat
caveat.default: Printed labels and visual estimates are distinguished on each point. Chart readings are not reported table figures.

value.title: Value
value.description: Value as read from the image (string, verbatim number)

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period printed for this point, when visible

printedOnChart.title: Printedonchart
printedOnChart.description: True if the number is printed as a data label; still not authoritative

table.title: Table
table.description: caption, title, units, columns, rowRange for table chunks

figure.title: Figure
figure.description: caption, classification, imageUrl for figure chunks

ChunkRef.title: ChunkRef
ChunkRef.description: A retrievable evidence chunk with exact source locations.

evidenceId.title: Evidenceid
evidenceId.description: Label used in this answer, e.g. 'E2'

workspaceEvidenceId.title: Workspaceevidenceid
workspaceEvidenceId.description: Matching Evidence.id in GET /documents/{id}/evidence ('ev-{blockId}'), if any

section.title: Section
section.description: Most recent heading text at or before this page; '' if none

extracted.title: Extracted
extracted.description: Reserved: semantic field extraction is not implemented

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Parser-reported confidence if any; never invented

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: An addressable, provenance-backed region.  It is *not* a verified financial fact.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Only populated when the Docling picture classifier is enabled

rowIndex.title: Rowindex
rowIndex.description: Row index in the parsed table grid

colIndices.title: Colindices
colIndices.description: Parsed grid columns merged into this value (e.g. '$' + number)

slotIndex.title: Slotindex
slotIndex.description: Value column after geometric alignment (0 = leftmost value column)

rowGroup.title: Rowgroup
rowGroup.description: Nearest preceding label-only row (e.g. section heading)

columnHeader.title: Columnheader
columnHeader.description: Verbatim header text aligned with this value column

cellText.title: Celltext
cellText.description: Verbatim value text (merged with adjacent currency/percent cells)

value.title: Value
value.description: Exact decimal value; null unless value_status='parsed'

scaleSource.title: Scalesource
scaleSource.description: Verbatim text the scale was read from

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO code when stated (USD...), 'dollar' when only '$'/'Dollars'

rowLabel.title: Rowlabel
rowLabel.description: Source row label / metric phrase quoted by the model

period.title: Period
period.description: Period claimed by the model (verified against the source)

factId.title: Factid
factId.description: Bound FinancialFact (table evidence normalized as facts)

periodType.title: Periodtype
periodType.description: Period type of the bound source column

binding.title: Binding
binding.description: How the operand was bound to evidence

level.title: Level
level.description: Heading level when reported by the parser

PageConfidence.title: PageConfidence
PageConfidence.description: Docling page-level confidence scores (0..1); null when the parser does not report them.

label.title: Label
label.description: Verbatim column header text the period was read from

endDate.title: Enddate
endDate.description: ISO date when a full date is printed (e.g. 2022-12-31)

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where a block came from: enough to re-locate it in the original PDF bytes.

documentIds.title: Documentids
documentIds.description: Restrict to these documents; null = route automatically

includeFigures.title: Includefigures
includeFigures.description: Attach chart interpretations (visual estimates) when available

note.title: Note
note.default: Answers are generated from retrieved evidence and validated deterministically; they are not audited facts.

score.title: Score
score.description: Fusion/method score used for ranking (not a probability)

documentIds.title: Documentids
documentIds.description: Restrict to these documents; null = all

TableData.title: TableData
TableData.description: Superset of frontend TableData.  `columns`/`rows` are verbatim cell text, no normalisation.

costUsd.title: Costusd
costUsd.description: Only when prices are configured; never estimated
